packageRules.description: Group non-major updates per ecosystem, not across them: a Rust bump and a container-image bump have nothing to do with each other and should not share a PR
Minor bumps of 0.x dependencies are semver-breaking in practice

nusb must resolve to a single version shared with seify-hackrfone, which depends on ^0.1.11. Taking 0.2 here compiles and passes the tests — no nusb type crosses the driver's API, so the two versions never meet — and silently links a second copy of the crate. Raise this bound when the driver does, not before
